content.text:
# RIGGING.md

Shipshape rigging for the TodoMVC shakedown build. Values, not procedure. Read on open by every role. Command values are one-line invocations; compose only the `{scenario}` placeholder and the tier tags from `## Tiers`. Every verification command excludes `@captain` and `@shipwright` scenarios, here via the cucumber.js default profile (`tags: 'not @captain and not @shipwright'`) and reaffirmed on the CLI.

## Stack

- language: JavaScript (vanilla, no framework, no preprocessors, no build step)
- runtime: Node.js
- packageManager: npm

## Directories

- implementation: js
- specs: features
- verification: features/support
- assets: assets
- assets: index.html
- assets: css
- scantlings: scantlings

`implementation` holds the only directory that carries planked seams (`js/`). `index.html` and `css/` are the shipped app shell and styles: product material in place, declared as assets. `assets/` holds the human-owned spec and template. `scantlings` holds the derived verification-conformance rule set.

## Commands

- discover: `npx cucumber-js --dry-run --tags "not @captain and not @shipwright"`
- focused: `s='{scenario}'; npx cucumber-js "${s%:*}" --name "${s##*:}" --tags "not @captain and not @shipwright"`
- broad: `npx cucumber-js --tags "not @captain and not @shipwright"`
- coverage: `npx c8 --include 'js/**' --include 'features/support/**' --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary --reports-dir=.wake/coverage npx cucumber-js --tags "not @captain and not @shipwright"`
- step-usage: `npx cucumber-js --format usage-json --tags "not @captain and not @shipwright" --dry-run`
- plank-inventory: `npx jsdoc -X -r js`
- typecheck: none
- lint: `npx biome check js features/support`

`focused` accepts the canonical `<spec>.feature:<Scenario Name>` reference verbatim; the shell wrapper splits it into cucumber's `--name` selector. `plank-inventory` emits jsdoc doclets; the `@planks("...")` and `@planks-provisional("...")` tokens live in each doclet's `comment` field and are joined against `step-usage` patterns by the methodology conformance scenarios. `typecheck` is `none`: plain JavaScript with no type checker in the stack. `lint` runs code lint only; feature lint is a gap (no Gherkin linter is installed), recorded in `AGENTS.md`. Biome is unconfigured; it reddens on the existing `var`-style code until Captain authors a `biome.json` matching the project style.

## Perturbation

- message: `PERTURBATION marks a behaviour-stable seam for reimplementation; a scenario exercising it fails with this message.`
- perturb: `throw new Error("PERTURBATION: seam under reimplementation");`

## Tiers

- default: @logic
- policy: Default tier renders the vanilla JS app in a happy-dom Window with no external accounts or network. Scenarios are untagged and belong to the default tier; the default tier is enumerated by the `not @captain and not @shipwright` exclusion (cucumber.js default profile). A `@logic` tier-tag watch selects nothing until scenarios carry the `@logic` tag, a Captain decision; until then the `broad` and `coverage` commands enumerate the default tier.
- weather: .wake/weather.json
- runrecord: .wake/runrecord.jsonl

No `@sandbox` tier is derived: the suite needs no real services beyond a local DOM. No `budget` ceiling is set: the full regression runs in well under one second.

## Dependencies

- policy: locked
- dependency: @cucumber/cucumber (Gherkin runner)
- dependency: happy-dom (default-tier DOM implementation)
- dependency: c8 (per-line and per-branch coverage)
- dependency: jsdoc (docblock-backed plank inventory)
- dependency: knip (dead-code and unused-export analysis)
- dependency: biome (code lint)

No product dependencies are installed: `index.html` references `css/app.css` (local) and `js/app.js` (local) and does not consume `todomvc-common` or `todomvc-app-css`, so the `assets/app-spec.md` mandate does not apply to this build. The lockfile is `package-lock.json`.

## Outbound

- outbound: none

This is a local TodoMVC application with no package registry publish, Docker image, or deploy target. Outbound is `none`; local green verification is sufficient.

All 51 scenarios pass. The lint errors are the pre-existing `var`-style code issues documented in RIGGING.md (Biome unconfigured) — my additions use `const`/`let` and follow existing style, introducing no new issues.

## Summary

**Problem:** While a todo row is in edit mode (after double-click), its checkbox, label, and delete button remained visible. The old CSS only hid `.toggle` and `.destroy` individually, leaving the `label` visible. (`index.html` already loads `css/app.css` correctly — no change needed there.)

**Fix — `css/app.css`:** Replaced the two per-element rules with one robust rule that hides the entire `.view` block (which wraps the checkbox, label, and destroy button) of an `li.editing`:

```css
.todo-list li.editing .view {
	display: none;
}
```

**Scenario — `features/editing-todos.feature`:** Broadened the existing Rule/scenario to also assert the label is hidden:
> *A todo's checkbox, label, and delete button are hidden while it is being edited* — checks toggle, label, and destroy are all hidden via CSS.

**Step definitions — `features/support/steps.js`:** Added `Then the label of the todo {string} is hidden`, and rewrote the three "is hidden" assertions to use a new `isHiddenByCss` helper.

**World helper — `features/support/world.js`:** Added `isHiddenByCss(el)`, which walks the element and its ancestors looking for `display: none`. This is necessary (and correct in real browsers too) because hiding the `.view` parent makes the subtree unrendered, yet `getComputedStyle(child).display` still reports the child's own resolved value (e.g. `inline-block`) rather than `none`. The old `getComputedStyle(el).display === 'none'` check would not reflect ancestor hiding.

**Verification:** Confirmed the new scenario fails when the CSS rule is removed and passes when present; full suite 51/51 green. No commit, push, or tag.
